quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #22
										  					
  

33 Questions • Passing Score 27

questions.question: If a vehicle using high beams comes toward you, where should you look?

options.text: Either side
The center
The right side
The left side

questions.correctAnswerText: The right side
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road. This prevents the other vehicle's bright headlights from blinding you. You can still see the road and stay on your course until the vehicle passes.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Do not enter.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. These lanes are for buses and vehicles with a driver and at least one passenger, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: You are in a line of traffic crossing railroad tracks with no signals or gates. What should you do?

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains.
You may pass slower drivers while crossing the track.
Make sure your vehicle can cross all the way without stopping.
All of the above

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure your vehicle can cross all the way without stopping.
questions.explanation: Check that you have enough space to completely cross the tracks before you drive on them. Never pass another vehicle at a railroad crossing. Always look for trains before crossing.

questions.question: For drivers 21 and older, it is illegal to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of:

options.text: 0.05 percent
0.08 percent
0.02 percent
0.1 percent

questions.correctAnswerText: 0.08 percent
questions.explanation: For drivers age 21 or older, a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher is illegal. Driving under the influence of alcohol is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: What do regulatory signs do?

options.text: Are placed everywhere there is present danger.
Tell drivers what they must or must not do.
Are diamond-shaped and yellow or green.
Warn drivers about school zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell drivers what they must or must not do.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually rectangular with black markings on white backgrounds. They show speed limits, no passing rules, no turning rules, and other driving laws.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop.
No U-turn.
Yield.
Do not enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not enter.
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: A leaking exhaust system can cause:

options.text: Excessive oil use.
Your vehicle to need a tune-up sooner.
You to become drowsy while driving.
Grass fires on country roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: You to become drowsy while driving.
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes toxic gases, reduces noise, and cools hot gases from the engine. Fumes from a leaky exhaust system can cause drowsiness while driving and can be deadly.

questions.question: A fire engine is following you on a two-lane street without using emergency signals. What should you do?

options.text: Continue driving normally.
Stop as quickly as you can.
Speed up to get out of its way.
Slow down, move right, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue driving normally.
questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is behind you without its siren or lights on, you do not need to move. Continue driving normally.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield.
Crossroad ahead.
Keep right.
Yield ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield.
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: A solid white line on the right edge of the highway slants toward the left. What does this mean?

options.text: There is an intersection just ahead.
You are approaching a construction area.
You will need to turn left just ahead.
The road will get narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will get narrower.
questions.explanation: A solid line on the road's edge marks its boundary. When the line angles toward the center, it means the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, which way should you turn the steering wheel?

options.text: Keep the front wheels straight.
In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
In the opposite direction of the skid.
In any direction. It doesn't matter.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
questions.explanation: Turn the steering wheel in the direction you want the vehicle to go. Once the vehicle begins to straighten out, turn the wheel back the other way.

questions.question: When should you allow more space in front of your vehicle than usual when stopping?

options.text: On an uphill slope.
At an intersection.
At a stop sign.
At a toll plaza.

questions.correctAnswerText: On an uphill slope.
questions.explanation: Allow extra space in front of your vehicle when stopped on an uphill slope. If the vehicle ahead rolls backward when traffic starts moving, you will have space to avoid a collision.

questions.question: What does a red flashing traffic light mean?

options.text: The same as a solid red light.
The same as a stop sign.
The same as a yield sign.
The same as a caution sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A red flashing traffic light means the same as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: A fully loaded tractor-trailer traveling at 55 mph could take up to ____ to stop completely.

options.text: 50 feet
125 feet
400 feet
750 feet

questions.correctAnswerText: 400 feet
questions.explanation: Large trucks take much longer to stop than cars at the same speed. A fully loaded tractor-trailer may take almost 400 feet to stop when traveling at 55 mph.

questions.question: What does a single broken yellow line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is allowed when safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken line means drivers next to it can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: Does drinking coffee after alcohol help you sober up?

options.text: Yes, it lowers blood alcohol level.
Yes, it cancels the effect of alcohol.
No, it has no effect on blood alcohol level.
No, it raises blood alcohol level.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, it has no effect on blood alcohol level.
questions.explanation: Coffee cannot lower your blood alcohol level. While it may help you stay awake, it will not make you sober or change your blood alcohol level.

questions.question: What is a speed limit?

options.text: The maximum or minimum legal speed during dangerous conditions.
The maximum or minimum legal speed during ideal conditions.
The suggested speed during ideal conditions.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum or minimum legal speed during ideal conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit is the legal maximum or minimum speed under ideal conditions. You can drive slower than the limit, but you cannot drive faster. In school zones, work zones, or bad weather, you must drive slower than the posted limit if conditions are unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Bicycle crossing.
Stop.
Fines double in a work zone.
Stop ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bicycle crossing.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings and tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: Which lane should you use to turn left from a multilane, one-way street?

options.text: The middle of the intersection.
The right lane.
The left lane.
Any lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane.
questions.explanation: To turn left from multilane streets and highways, start from the left lane.

questions.question: Why should drivers be extra alert to motorcyclists, bicyclists, and pedestrians?

options.text: They are hard to see in traffic.
They follow different traffic laws than cars.
They always have the right-of-way.
They don't have rearview mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are hard to see in traffic.
questions.explanation: In many accidents, drivers said they were looking but did not see motorcycles, bicycles, or pedestrians. These are harder to spot because they are smaller and have less noticeable lighting. Always watch for these smaller and more vulnerable road users.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a steady yellow arrow at a traffic signal?

options.text: Merge into the lane that the arrow points to.
Slow down and stop if it is safe to do so.
You can turn left after letting oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
You have the right-of-way and oncoming traffic must stop for you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stop if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow arrow means a red arrow is coming next. Stop unless you are already in the intersection.

questions.question: A driver extends their left arm and hand downward. What does this hand signal mean?

options.text: Turn left.
Turn right.
Stop.
Start moving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point downward, they are signaling that they plan to stop. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a steady green arrow at a traffic signal?

options.text: Merge into the lane that the arrow points to.
Slow down and stop if it is safe to do so.
You can turn in the direction of the arrow after letting traffic and pedestrians already in the intersection pass.
You can drive straight through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn in the direction of the arrow after letting traffic and pedestrians already in the intersection pass.
questions.explanation: A green arrow tells you that you can turn in that direction. You must be in the correct lane. Let any traffic or pedestrians already in the intersection go first.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) depends on all of the following except:

options.text: Your body weight.
How much you drink.
How much time passes between drinks.
How physically fit you are.

questions.correctAnswerText: How physically fit you are.
questions.explanation: Your BAC depends on how much alcohol you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your body weight. Your level of fitness does not affect your BAC.

questions.question: You must not drive faster than:

options.text: The maximum speed limit.
A speed that is faster than is reasonable and safe.
A speed that is safe for current road and weather conditions.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: You must not drive faster than is reasonable and safe. You must drive at a speed that matches the area, traffic, pedestrians, weather, road quality, and light. You must also obey all posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A left curve is ahead.
A series of curves is ahead.
An S-curve is ahead.
The road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road becomes slippery when it is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is especially slippery when wet.

questions.question: You are approaching an intersection with a flashing yellow light. What should you do?

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to change.
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed.
Drive carefully through the intersection.
Get ready to stop because the light is about to turn red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive carefully through the intersection.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed with caution. Look both ways before entering the intersection.

questions.question: If you move, how long do you have to report your new address to the Driver License Bureau?

options.text: Two weeks.
15 days.
10 days.
One month.

questions.correctAnswerText: 10 days.
questions.explanation: You must notify the Driver License Bureau within 10 days of a change of address. You can get forms from your county treasurer, a highway patrol officer, a driver license examiner, or online.

questions.question: A speed restriction sign shows:

options.text: A speed you can ignore in rain, snow, or ice.
A triangular shape.
Blue letters on a black background.
A recommended speed for a curve or turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: A recommended speed for a curve or turn.
questions.explanation: Curve and turn warning signs often have a speed sign below them showing the recommended speed for that curve or turn. Never ignore this speed in bad weather conditions.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: It is okay to follow a motorcycle closely.
A motorcycle with two riders is more balanced than one with a single rider.
You must move completely into the left lane when passing a motorcycle.
You can expect a motorcycle's brake lights to come on when they slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must move completely into the left lane when passing a motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are entitled to a full lane of space. Make sure your vehicle is completely in the left lane before passing a motorcycle.

questions.question: When you see a flashing yellow arrow at a traffic signal, what should you do?

options.text: Merge into the lane in the direction of the arrow.
Come to a complete stop.
You can turn left after letting oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
You have the right-of-way and oncoming traffic must stop for you.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn left after letting oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow arrow means you can turn left in the direction of the arrow. But you must yield first. Oncoming traffic has a green light, so you must let them and pedestrians pass before you turn.

questions.question: Why is it important to watch carefully for motorcycles?

options.text: They are harder to see than cars.
They rarely use their headlights.
Motorcycle riders are less skilled than other drivers.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are harder to see than cars.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are smaller than cars, so they are easy to miss. They can hide in your blind spot. It is hard to judge how far away they are or how fast they are moving. Always be alert and careful around motorcycles.

questions.question: What traffic signal means you must stop, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, and then go when it is safe?

options.text: A solid red light.
A flashing yellow light.
A solid green light.
A flashing red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: A flashing red light.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, and then go when it is safe.
